title: Cockles and Mussels (Molly Malone)
description: A delightful rendition of Cockles and Mussels (Molly Malone) for children.

lyrics.text: In Dublin's fair city, where girls are so pretty,
I first set my eyes on sweet Molly Malone.
She wheeled her wheel-barrow, through streets broad and narrow,
Crying cockles and mussels, alive, alive-o!
